episodes.synopsis: Goro's luggage is stolen at the airport in Los Angeles. He then receives help from Hayato, a Japanese citizen also trying out for the major leagues.
episodes.title: To the Home of Baseball

episodes.synopsis: Goro and Hayato both pass the first test at tryouts. For the second test, the rookies must stage a come-from-behind victory against a Single-A team.
episodes.title: Tryouts

episodes.synopsis: Hayato's hit leads to two runs, but Nick's selfish play puts the team's comeback effort in jeopardy. A blister causes Goro to struggle with pitching.
episodes.title: I'll Do It!

episodes.synopsis: Goro is given a chance at a roster spot in the majors with the Salmons. He quickly gets into a scuffle during practice with the Salmons' ace pitcher.
episodes.title: This is Major!

episodes.synopsis: After realizing how much he needs to improve,Goro gets off to a strong start pitching in his first major league exhibition game.
episodes.title: Guide to the World

episodes.synopsis: In his first Triple-A game, Goro throws off the Falcons with his new curve-ball, but it doesn't work for long. He then faces an unexpected opponent.
episodes.title: Unforgivable!!

episodes.synopsis: Goro tries out for the Memphis Bats after being released by the Cougars. He runs into a Japanese girl at the airport, and his luggage is stolen again.
episodes.title: Courage, full score!

episodes.synopsis: Alice convinces Goro to serve as the Bats' closer. In Japan, the number one draft pick Toshiya Sato draws attention in the Warriors' game.
episodes.title: Debut!

episodes.synopsis: Toshiya's confidence suffers an unexpected blow during the game, but his coach still decides to start him in the exhibition match.
episodes.title: Challenger

episodes.synopsis: Goro is adapting to life in America. Meanwhile in Japan, the Seishu High graduates reflect on their time spent with Goro and take their next steps.
episodes.title: It's Not Impossible

episodes.synopsis: The Bats start the season with the worst record in the division. Moved by Sanders' desire to win a championship, Goro tries motivating his teammates.
episodes.title: Try and aim for it

episodes.synopsis: The Bats rise to second in the division. Now playing baseball in college, Komori serves as a substitute coach for a Little League team.
episodes.title: Liar!

episodes.synopsis: Goro racks up 19 saves as the Bats rise to the top of their division. The team gets a new player, and the coach demotes Sanders to the bench.
episodes.title: A Stupid Bet

episodes.synopsis: The Bats are winning, but Goro is unsatisfied with Keene's style of play. Alice explains Keene's behavior by talking about an event in his past.
episodes.title: Keene's Past

episodes.synopsis: Sanders replaces Keene in the starting lineup for the first time in a while, but his rusty play results in snapping the Bats' winning streak.
episodes.title: Hero

episodes.synopsis: The summer high school baseball tournament has begun. Now captain of Seishu High, Taiga is annoyed by the behavior of his team during training.
episodes.title: I'm fed up!

episodes.synopsis: Goro and the Bats hit a rough patch, so his teammates invite him on a drive to cheer him up. Shimizu's friends try jump-starting her love life.
episodes.title: Where to Aim

episodes.synopsis: Alice visits her grandfather in hospital. He seems healthy, but his condition suddenly turns serious after the Bats suffer a humiliating home loss.
episodes.title: Alice's Dream, Everyone's Dream

episodes.synopsis: After the Bats make the playoffs, six players including Goro and Keene are called up to the majors. Goro has mixed feelings about his promotion.
episodes.title: Responsibility

episodes.synopsis: The Bats win their series against the Sharks to advance to the finals, where they will face the Falcons -- and the indomitable Gibson Jr.
episodes.title: Get out!

episodes.synopsis: The first game of the finals begins. Driven by their bet, Goro and Gibson Jr. both give it their all. The Bats fall behind in the first inning.
episodes.title: Trouble from the Start

episodes.synopsis: Goro's hand injury causes him to lose control over his pitching. After he unintentionally walks consecutive batters, Gibson Jr. steps up to the plate.
episodes.title: The Single Ball of Fate

episodes.synopsis: Star rookies Toshiya and Mayumura face off in the finals in Japan. Toshiya is in low spirits after his team suffers consecutive losses.
episodes.title: One More Deciding Match

episodes.synopsis: Gibson Jr.'s unfinished business with Goro causes him to struggle in the majors -- until he sees the news that Goro has returned from injury.
episodes.title: A Great Man

episodes.synopsis: In the championship-deciding game, Goro gets a chance at bat with a runner on base. To his disappointment, he is told to make a sacrificial bunt.
episodes.title: A Truly Worthy Rival

episodes.synopsis: The final game goes to extra innings. In the bottom of the 10th inning, Goro and Gibson Jr. have one last showdown to decide the champion.
episodes.title: An Oath
